scope: Selected exact source/capture copies read after execution. Native binary hashes are separately read back; binaries remain in the Actions artifact. Outer controller/qualifier source copies are read-after identities, not independent capture-time byte pins.

credential_scan.scope: Owned admin/dashboard/TUI token files and named token values from available HTTP bodies read privately; not a proof of absence of every possible secret. Raw HTTP/provider logs, auth configuration, native binaries and full runtime are excluded.
